newsitem.title: USA: Clorox declares two-for-one stock split.
newsitem.headline: Clorox declares two-for-one stock split.

text.p: Clorox Co said it declared a two-for-one stock split and authorized a 10.3 percent increase in the annual dividend rate.
The company said the quarterly cash dividend was boosted to $0.64 per share from $0.58 on a pre-split basis, payable August 15 to shareholders of record on July 28.
The company said this will be the 21st consecutive annual increase in the dividend.
The additional shares resulting from the split will be distributed on September 2 to shareholders of record on July 28, the company said.
Clorox is a manufacturer of household grocery products and automotive cleaning products marketed in the United States and internationally.
